answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by tying influence to a verified history and escalating collateral. Each identity posts a bond, completes unpredictable tasks, and receives signatures from reviewers outside its social cluster. An anchor links every reward to auditable work, while ferrous-weighted collateral becomes more expensive after failed audits. An opal reputation score grows only through independent agreement, so copied identities lose access and mass fabrication becomes uneconomic.
